musl_runtime_note: The ELF is dynamically linked to libc.musl-aarch64.so.1 and libstdc++.so.6. The loader and shared libraries already present for the Termux V1 installation were copied into the V2 lib directory. No OpenCode V1 code is executed by opencode2.
install_method: Official installer script inspected; it selects linux-arm64 (glibc), which cannot run on Android bionic. The official musl platform artifact was downloaded from the npm registry, SHA-512 integrity checked, and extracted into an isolated directory. This is the same artifact the official installer uses for musl Linux.

known_limitation.symptom: opencode run --standalone -> Error: Standalone server exited before reporting readiness
known_limitation.cause: The CLI self-spawns using its executable path. Because the Termux launch path is the musl loader, it tries `ld-musl ... serve` and cannot load `serve`.
known_limitation.mitigation: tools/oc2run starts the official server explicitly and points the official client at it. Service/self-spawn commands remain unsupported.
known_limitation.not_claimed: This is not an official Android/Termux support claim. The official docs list Linux glibc/musl only.
